rules.statement: A donation made by a person in favour of his daughter-in-law in contemplation of her marriage with the donor's son is revocable under Kandyan Law.
rules.supporting_quote: "Therefore after the said marriage I nor my heirs, &c, shall raise any objection or dispute to the grant herein made, and the donee, the said Dingiri Menika, and her heirs, &c, shall possess the same after the said marriage."
